text.en: Every flatworm has a gut with exactly one opening.

modelCorrection.en: Tapeworms are flatworms with no gut at all. They absorb food through the body surface.

text.en: A roundworm's food goes in through a mouth and waste leaves through a separate anus.
Whether an animal is a parasite is decided by how many openings it has.

modelCorrection.en: A parasite lives in or on a host. Flatworms and roundworms both include parasites and worms that live freely.
